requirements.text: The ERP solution must replace the City's Eden financial modules: General Ledger, Purchasing, Contract Management, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Project and Grant Accounting, and Capital Assets.
requirements.quote: Eden | General Ledger; Purchasing; Contract Management; Accounts Payable; Accounts Receivable; Project and Grant Accounting; Capital Assets | Replace | N/A
requirements.note: ERP Environment table, page 5, image only; transcribed from the page render.

requirements.text: The ERP solution must replace the City's Eden Human Resources, Time and Attendance, and Payroll modules, as part of the ERP suite or integrated with it.
requirements.quote: Eden | Human Resources; Time and Attendance; Payroll | Replace | Yes or Part of ERP Suite
requirements.note: ERP Environment table, page 5, image only.

requirements.text: The ERP solution must replace the Quadrant cashiering system, as part of the ERP suite or integrated with it.
requirements.quote: Quadrant | Cashiering | Replace | Yes or Part of ERP Suite
requirements.note: ERP Environment table, page 5, image only.

requirements.text: The ERP solution must replace the Excel-based budget process, as part of the ERP suite or integrated with it.
requirements.quote: Excel | Budget | Replace | Yes or Part of ERP Suite
requirements.note: ERP Environment table, page 5, image only.

requirements.text: The ERP solution must replace the Excel-based preparation of the Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR), as part of the ERP suite or integrated with it.
requirements.quote: Excel | ACFR | Replace | Yes or Part of ERP Suite
requirements.note: ERP Environment table, page 5, image only.

requirements.text: The ERP solution must integrate with the retained systems NeoGov (recruiting), Power Time (police scheduling, time and attendance), Amanda and MBC.com (permitting, planning, land management), RecTrac (parks and recreation) and Class (Dumas Bay Conference Center).
requirements.quote: NeoGov | Recruiting | Retain | Yes; Power Time | Scheduling, Time and Attendance - Police | Retain | Yes; Amanda | Permitting, Planning, Land Management | Retain | Yes; MBC.com (MyBuildingPermit.com) | Permitting, Planning, Land Management | Retain | Yes; RecTrac | Parks and Recreation | Retain | Yes; Class | Dumas Bay Conference Center | Retain | Yes
requirements.note: ERP Environment table, page 5, image only. Esri GIS and SeeClick Fix are retained with no integration.

requirements.text: Integration of the ERP solution with OpenGov (constituent transparency) and SharePoint (document management) is under review.
requirements.quote: OpenGov | Constituent Transparency | Retain | Review; SharePoint | Document Management | Retain | Review
requirements.note: ERP Environment table, page 5, image only.

requirements.text: Enterprise asset management and fleet management, currently Excel shadow systems, are under review for inclusion in scope; their integration is to be determined.
requirements.quote: Excel, Shadow System | Enterprise Asset Management | Reviewing | TBD; Excel, Shadow System | Fleet Management | Reviewing | TBD
requirements.note: ERP Environment table, page 5, image only.
